doc.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Rowe thanks him; they discuss his festival schedule and say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Well I want to thank you for coming and sharing your life story with us.
Yeah. I think I covered all the bases.
I hope you have a good weekend here. They seem to have you working pretty hard.
Well yeah. Not today, one set.
They’ll probably make up for it the next three days.
It’s okay, it’s four each day — two in the afternoons and two in the evenings.
Right. Well thanks for your time, and on behalf of Hamilton College, I appreciate it.
Yeah. I appreciate your having me.
